LanguageData.ChargeableBionics.EnableProstheticPatche: When enabled, basic industrial prosthetics (prosthetic limbs, cochlear implants, power claws, and similar Royalty implants) also need to be recharged, using a lower capacity tier than true bionics. When disabled, these prosthetics behave as in vanilla.
LanguageData.ChargeableBionics.ColonyPawnsOnly: Limit chargeable bionics to colony pawns
LanguageData.ChargeableBionics.ColonyPawnsOnlyTooltip: Only permanent player-faction pawns, including colony animals and slaves, use chargeable bionics. Prisoners and temporary guests are excluded.
LanguageData.ChargeableBionics.RestartRequired: Restart Rimworld to apply these changes.
